generator.params.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 233-234), Encephalartos septentrionalis: stem globose, generally subterranean or to 2 m tall, 25 to 30 cm across; leaves numerous, 0.9 to 1.5 m long, the petiole 2.5 to 5 cm; leaflets in 40 to 50 pairs, 7.5 to 18 cm by 1.5 to 3.5 cm, at about 80 degrees. Drawn as a trunk 0.14 m in radius, rising 0.015 m a year; fronds 1.2 m long, the petiole 0.04 of them, 44 pairs of leaflets, the longest leaflet 0.11 of the frond; 10 fronds a year, as the crown's count over the three years a frond lives (estimated); first cones at 10 years (estimated, as the research note's timing table records). Female cone on a peduncle 25 to 30 cm, pendulous; male cones up to 8 to 10 a crown on slender peduncles 15 to 30 cm (their posture not given: leaning, estimated).

appearance.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 233-234), Encephalartos septentrionalis: its leaflets drawn as wide, for their length, as the median leaflets it gives; the rest of its look from its order and family.

allometry.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 233-234), Encephalartos septentrionalis: stem globose, generally subterranean or to 2 m tall, 25 to 30 cm across; leaves numerous, 0.9 to 1.5 m long, the petiole 2.5 to 5 cm; leaflets in 40 to 50 pairs, 7.5 to 18 cm by 1.5 to 3.5 cm, at about 80 degrees. The whole plant's height at 60 years estimated from these, its stem (or none, where it stays underground) under a crown of young leaves standing about 0.85 of a leaf above it: about 2.3 m. Whitelock gives no ages, so the tolerance is wide.

traits.cone_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 233-234), Encephalartos septentrionalis: female cone 18 to 20 cm across.

traits.cone_face_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 233), Encephalartos septentrionalis: the megasporophyll's face 2 to 2.7 by 4.5 to 5 cm, faceted, projecting 2 to 2.5 cm.

traits.cone_shape.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 233-234), Encephalartos septentrionalis: female cone cylindrical.

traits.cone_colour.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 233-234), Encephalartos septentrionalis: female cone blue-green turning olive, then yellow-brown; the ripe colour by eye.

traits.pollen_cone_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 233-234), Encephalartos septentrionalis: male cone 6 to 8 cm across.

traits.pollen_cone_face_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 233), Encephalartos septentrionalis: microsporophylls 2.3 to 2.9 cm long, the face 0.6 to 1 by 1.5 to 2.5 cm.

traits.pollen_cone_shape.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 233-234), Encephalartos septentrionalis: male cones narrowly ellipsoid.

traits.pollen_cone_colour.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 233-234), Encephalartos septentrionalis: male cone blue-green turning olive, then dark yellow-brown; the shedding colour by eye.

traits.seed_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 233-234), Encephalartos septentrionalis: sclerotesta 1.6 to 2.4 cm across.

traits.seed_colour_ripe.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 233-234), Encephalartos septentrionalis: sarcotesta deep red when ripe; the colour by eye.

traits.sexual_system.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 233-234), Encephalartos septentrionalis: male and female cones on separate plants, as in every cycad (p. 19).
